tools.name: tts_list_protocols
tools.description: List all built-in text-to-speech protocols, their default endpoints, authentication styles, and supported parameters.

tools.name: tts_list_profiles
tools.description: List configured speech synthesis profiles (the default profile from plugin settings plus any named profiles loaded from the profiles config file), without exposing secret keys.

tools.name: tts_synthesize
tools.description: Synthesize speech audio to a file inside the active project directory and return its path, byte size, and measured duration in seconds. Pass short single-line text via 'text', or write longer or multi-line narration to a project file and pass its relative path via 'text_file'.

output_path.description: Relative output audio file path inside the active project directory (for example 'audio/intro.mp3').

text.description: Short single-line text to synthesize. For multi-line or long narration, save the script to a file and use text_file instead.

text_file.description: Relative path inside the active project directory to a UTF-8 text file whose contents will be synthesized.

protocol.description: Optional protocol override for this request.

model.description: Model, resource ID, or cluster override.

format.description: Output audio format override (inferred from output_path extension when omitted).

sample_rate.description: Output sample rate in Hz (for example 16000, 24000, 32000, 44100, 48000).

speed.description: Speaking rate multiplier (1.0 is normal speed; typically 0.5 to 2.0).

volume.description: Volume multiplier (1.0 is normal volume; typically 0.5 to 2.0).

pitch.description: Pitch adjustment (1.0 is neutral for ratio-based APIs; semitones/ratio mapped per protocol).

emotion.description: Optional speaking emotion or style supported by the target voice (for example happy, sad, neutral, excited).

emotion_scale.description: Optional emotion intensity (for example 1 to 5 on Volcengine).

language.description: Optional language hint (for example zh-CN, en-US, Auto).

instructions.description: Optional speaking style instruction (for protocols such as OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts).

tools.name: tts_synthesize_batch
tools.description: Batch synthesize video voiceover segments from a JSON script or SRT subtitle file inside the active project directory. Writes one audio file per segment plus a timing manifest JSON containing actual durations (and subtitle target/overflow durations for SRT files).

script_path.description: Relative path inside the active project directory to a JSON voiceover script or SRT subtitle file.

output_dir.description: Relative directory inside the active project directory where generated segment audio files will be saved.

manifest_path.description: Optional relative path for the output timing manifest JSON (defaults to '<output_dir>/manifest.json').

profile.description: Default named profile for segments that do not specify one.

voice.description: Default voice override for segments that do not specify one.

format.description: Default audio format for segments that do not specify one.

speed.description: Default speaking rate multiplier for segments that do not specify one.

start_index.description: Zero-based index of the first segment to process (useful for chunking large scripts).

limit.description: Maximum number of segments to synthesize in this call (default 20, max 50).

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent synthesis requests (1 to 5, default 3).

skip_existing.description: When true, skip synthesis for segments whose output file already exists and report its measured duration.

continue_on_error.description: When true (default), record per-segment errors and continue synthesizing remaining segments.
